definitions.distinct_description: short/full description is nonempty and differs from normalized title; counted per Master
definitions.description_any: at least one short or full description field is populated
definitions.raw_source_category: raw payload key contains category/industry/theme/classification/taxonomy; master-level presence
definitions.other_structured_classification: classification-like payload key exists; availability only, values can still be generic or unmapped
definitions.title_only: title exists and no supported non-title sector signal is available; includes generic/contextual titles and is an availability diagnostic, not a claim that the title is sector-indicative
definitions.no_useful_sector_signal: no empirically supported canonical activity/sub-activity/raw mapping, semantic source-activity hint, distinct description phrase, meaningful asset signal, or non-contextual title phrase. Generic labels and contextual mentions are excluded.
